sources.title: Florida DT Caleb Banks is a boom/bust prospect
sources.description: One prospect the Denver Broncos have shown some interest in and may select in the second round of the 2026 NFL Draft is Florida defensive tackle Caleb Banks. He is a 6-6, 327-pound defensive tackle who is highly talented but comes with some injury questions. The Athletic’s lead draft analyst, Dane Brugler, has Caleb Banks […]
